name: Oli O'Connor
headline: Co-Founder at Field | Shopify Plus & UI/UX for D2C Brands | Percival, David Austin Roses, This Works
post_snippet: I'll be the first to admit I was a bit of a B Corp skeptic. For a long time, I thought B Corp was reserved for the brands we work with. It's about the framework of how you treat your people and the planet. We've officially certified with an Overall B Impact Score of 87.7.
comment_draft: For service companies B Corp ends up being a mirror rather than a framework to retrofit. When you're already running that way, the 87.7 score is confirmation, not achievement.

name: Shawn Khemsurov
headline: Co-Owner @ Electric Eye (Shopify Plus Agency) & Govalo (Shopify Gift Card App)
post_snippet: Finally made it over to Japan! Everyone was so polite, food was unreal, service top notch, and best shopping I've ever seen. It was really cool to see small businesses that focus on small niches in small spaces with no pressure to be massive.
comment_draft: The retailers that stick with you in Japan are the ones completely unbothered by volume. Deep expertise, small space, loyal regulars. That model applies pretty well to agency work too.

name: Shobhit Nigam
headline: Driving $150M+ in Sales | 5100+ Shopify Stores Delivered | Crafting 3X Conversions & Retention
post_snippet: AI commerce works best with structured systems. Most e-commerce ecosystems are anything but structured. A lot of growing brands today operate through disconnected apps, fragmented customer data, inconsistent product information. AI is not just changing marketing. It's exposing how scalable or fragile ecommerce systems actually are underneath.
comment_draft: Fragmentation compounds quietly because each new tool solves a pain at the time. Clean catalog data and connected systems are what AI actually needs to act on intent, not just surface recommendations.

name: Cory Anderson
headline: CEO of Stratos ERP Partners and Co-Founder of Suite Enrich | NetSuite Alliance Partner | NetSuite Consulting and Celigo Integrations | AI Based Data Enrichment in NetSuite
post_snippet: Suite Enrich AI transforms incomplete NetSuite records into rich data for sales, marketing, and executive teams. Automatically fills in missing details such as location, company information, social profiles, images, and AI insights using Patent Pending Technology. There is no manual work or copy-pasting involved; just complete data.
comment_draft: NetSuite data quality is usually the unglamorous bottleneck. Enrichment at the record level fixes reporting and segmentation upstream, instead of patching it with manual audits after the fact.

name: John C.
headline: Managing Partner & CEO @ XPLORER DRiV | Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner
post_snippet: The moment discovery gets real is usually not when Finance starts asking questions. It is when the Operations team does. You are talking to a prospect discussing their business for a NetSuite demo. Then someone asks what happens when the teardown reveals more work, more cost, and more time than anyone expected.
comment_draft: Operations discovery is where real scope appears. Finance follows the ERP story, but the moment a teardown reveals mid-job branching, the conversation moves to where generic demos fall short.
